fusions.name: Corral Snare
fusions.desc: Lays a 6-tile loop ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Turn the Stray
fusions.desc: Flicks the lash at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full reach, and the target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Head 'Em Up
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash over your allies' heads: for 10 seconds, every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power.

fusions.name: The Long Drive
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
